commands: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=best_effort record:=true bag_dir:=evidence/pr05/bag
timeout 5s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose turtlesim/msg/Pose --qos-reliability reliable --once

defect.reproducer: best_effort publisher with reliable subscriber: topic visible, received=0, RELIABILITY warning, echo timeout exit 124.
defect.root_cause: The reliable subscription requests stronger reliability than the best_effort publisher offers.
defect.proof_after: With best_effort subscription the live counter increases and echo receives a Pose with exit 0. The same MCAP replay with unchanged QoS override gives reliable exit 124 and best_effort exit 0; bag and YAML hashes match in both checks.
